README.md

Species pools of novel ecosystems: regional donor habitats and unrealized native diversity

This repository stores all the information related to the manuscript Species pools of novel ecosystems: regional donor habitats and unrealized native diversity, including the datasets, the scripts to perform data cleaning and analysis, and the Rmarkdown files to create the manuscript.

Contents

This repository is organised following the advice of Wilson et al. 2017 for recording and storing research projects.

The following materials are available in the folders of this repository:

  • data Data files.
  • src Scripts in R language to perform the analyses and produce the figures of the manuscript.
  • results Output of the R scripts, including figures and model outputs.
  • doc Manuscript files.

Citation

Please cite the repository, datasets and article as:

  1. Species pools of novel ecosystems: regional donor habitats and unrealized native diversity.
